capabilities: Highlights adverbs, passive voice, hedges, weasel words, clichés and doubled words
Flags long sentences past a configurable threshold with a second tier for very long ones
Shows a Flesch reading grade, live counts and a rhythm map
Masks code, math, frontmatter, URLs, comments, headings and table rows before analysis
Adds Pro tools: de-slop marks, echo detector, revision delta and focus mode
extras: Free tier is uncapped; Pro is a $12 one-time offline license key. English only, passive detection is heuristic, notes above a configurable size threshold are skipped, and the status bar grade is desktop-only. The plugin never writes to notes and makes no network calls.
motivation: Built so writers can tighten bloated drafts inside Obsidian and get marks on the sentence they are writing rather than on the Markdown syntax around it.
problem: Most Obsidian writing tools pull you out of the editor or lint raw Markdown, flagging code, URLs and frontmatter as if they were prose.
summary: Editor highlighter that marks adverbs, passive voice, hedges, clichés and long sentences and shows a Flesch reading grade.
